purpose: Compare repository-specific design harnesses without changing the model, task, repository, runtime, or grading contract between conditions.

conditions.label: No repository design harness
conditions.allowedContext: Repository instructions and task fixture only

conditions.label: Memi 2.7
conditions.allowedContext: Pinned Memi release with deterministic routing and trace receipts

conditions.label: Superpowers
conditions.allowedContext: Pinned public release and its documented activation workflow

conditions.label: Everything Claude Code
conditions.allowedContext: Pinned public release and its documented activation workflow

outcomes.efficiencyRule: Report only among quality-non-inferior conditions; never trade an unbounded quality loss for lower cost.

analysis.uncertainty: paired bootstrap confidence intervals plus exact sign tests
analysis.qualityGate: lower confidence bound is non-inferior to baseline
analysis.rankingGate: no cross-harness rank until all admitted conditions complete the same frozen cells
analysis.missingness: report by cause; do not encode missing or failed runs as zero-quality wins for another condition
